sloka: तयोस्तद्भाषितं श्रुत्वा कौतूहलसमन्वितम् ।कथयामास काकुत्स्थस्तस्य राज्ञो यथागतम् ।। ७.८८.४ ॥
transliteration: tayostadbhāṣitaṁ śrutvā kautūhalasamanvitam ।kathayāmāsa kākutsthastasya rājño yathāgatam ।। 7.88.4 ॥

translations.english: Hearing their speech, which was full of curiosity, Rama (Kakutstha) narrated the king's story exactly as it had happened.
